scope.en: Aorta and selected major arterial branches only:15 source structures in9 meshes. Open rims and unfused intersections remain; no complete circulation, continuous lumen or whole-body registration.
scope.zh: 仅主动脉与部分主要动脉分支：15个来源结构组成9个网格。保留开放端缘和未融合交叉表面；不代表完整循环、连续管腔或全身配准。

gatePolicy: Verbatim existing gallery gates; no new validation or gate/count change.

historicalReview.status: Existing scoped static visual acceptance; retained, not re-reviewed in this migration
historicalReview.scope: Static aorta plus selected major arterial branch exterior improvement
limitations: Selected aorta, arch branches, renal trunks and common/external iliac arteries only; not veins, lymphatics, peripheral nerves, full arterial tree or full circulation.
Native Z-Anatomy world frame only; not BodyParts3D 4.0 or CT registration. Isolated viewer only; no default whole-body replacement.
15 named source structures represented by9 meshes; only six numerically coincident curve endpoints joined, with source handles/radii retained.
Open end rims and intersecting unfused branch surfaces remain. Each of9 meshes has40 boundary edges after exact tuple remap; not a closed-volume or continuous-lumen pass.
Bidirectional sampled vertex-to-surface discrepancy from independently densified original curves is at most0.0743mm; this is not analytic Hausdorff distance.
Static visual exterior scope only; no browser-runtime, motion, clinical or expert-anatomy validation.

sourceFrame: Z-Anatomy native evaluated world only; separate from BP3D/CT. No recentering, alignment or default whole-body assembly.
warnings: 15 source structures in 9 exterior meshes; selected arterial subset, not complete circulation.
Open end rims and unfused intersecting branch surfaces remain; 40 boundary edges per mesh in the historical exact-tuple audit.
No closed-volume/continuous-lumen/flow, veins, lymphatics, nerves, whole-body registration or clinical/runtime pass.
changes: Historical r02 joins six numerically coincident native curve endpoints with matching radii, retains source control points/handles, and increases longitudinal/bevel sampling. No new paths or lumen. This migration makes no geometry/material/transform edits.

failureLesson.en: Source joins and caps must be inspected; partial exterior coherence is not a continuous lumen.
failureLesson.zh: 必须检查源模型接合与端盖；局部外观连贯不等于连续管腔。
